title: CareLine Service Plans Schedule of Benefit Start, Warranty Priority and Other-Make Parts
content:
**Plan agreement schedule — CareLine Service Plans.**

(a) **Waiting period.** Plan repair benefits — free trips, the parts discount, and included weatherstripping and rescreening — apply only after a waiting period of calendar days after the enrolled date. Tune-ups are available at once.

(b) **Warranty first.** On every tier, a repair to a component inside an active Ridgeline warranty's terms is handled under the warranty instead of the plan.

(c) **Other makes.** On every tier, parts are not supplied for windows and doors not made by Ridgeline; only labor is offered on them.

| Tier | Waiting period after the enrolled date (calendar days) | Repair inside an active Ridgeline warranty's terms handled under the warranty | Parts supplied for windows and doors of other makers |
|---|---|---|---|
| On-Call Service Account | 0 | Yes | No (labor only) |
| CareLine Basic Plan | 30 | Yes | No (labor only) |
| CareLine Plus Plan | 30 | Yes | No (labor only) |
| CareLine Premier Plan | 30 | Yes | No (labor only) |
| CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | 30 | Yes | No (labor only) |
| CareLine Estate Plan | 30 | Yes | No (labor only) |

### Notes

- A waiting period of 30 calendar days on the CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year and Estate plans applies to the repair benefits only; the annual tune-ups of those plans are available from the enrolled date.
- The On-Call Service Account has a waiting period of 0 days.

### Points of reading

**Does the waiting period hold back a tune-up on a CareLine Premier Plan enrolled last week?** No. Tune-ups are available at once on every tier.

**Is a sliding door made by another manufacturer repaired under a CareLine plan?** Labor is offered on it; parts are not supplied for it.
